metadata.description: Terminal-style GitHub profile skills: design one from profile.toml, review any existing one.

plugins.name: github-profile-designer
plugins.description: Design, generate and maintain an animated terminal-style GitHub profile README as self-contained SVGs, refreshed daily by GitHub Actions.

plugins.name: github-profile-review
plugins.description: Audit and score any GitHub profile README for what silently breaks on github.com, with a ranked fix list.
